question: Compare the expressed-minus-neutral vision-1 herbivore descendant-breeder frequency change between the accepted and deterministic eight-patch food habitats.
claim_scope: One seen-seed engineering interaction; not formal evidence, pure causal vision utility, food-discovery validation, general fitness, coexistence qualification, or habitat robustness.
primary_endpoint: I = D_patched - D_accepted; D_habitat = (p_breeder_expressed - p_founder_expressed) - (p_breeder_neutral - p_founder_neutral).

validation.shelter_prototype_note: 11 pure tests from separate prototype commit 3deef3a are included in combined count; prototype is not part of this World study.

limitations: One seen-seed engineering calibration is not a formal estimate.
Food path lengths are bounded-perception records, not discoveries or successful meals.
Feature and habitat changes permit RNG-path divergence; the arm comparison is not an exact counterfactual.
Potential capacity and nominal refill totals do not force equal realized renewals.
The 200-tick engineering run is not a coexistence qualification; carnivore descendant-breeder maturity was not required.
Four formal seed blocks are the replication units; the mean interaction is positive but only one of four block interactions is positive and the median is negative.
All eight within-habitat expressed-minus-neutral breeder-frequency changes were negative; the mixed interaction is not a consistent vision advantage.

formal.unit_of_replication: seed block of 2 habitats × 2 trait arms

runtime.aggregate_snapshot_scope: recorded after execution and root/geometry audits, before aggregate summary writing and archival; not a post-archive directory-size measurement

formal.archive_status: five lossless archives independently verified; original and compressed hashes match the archive inventory
